verdicts.reason: A breaks reading order: the badges and the 'Find It Near You' CTA sit in the middle, to the left of the headline, so the eye hits the action before the message. GLACIER floats on its own and lines up with nothing, and the body copy is tiny and cramped against the right edge. B reads properly left to right (can, then headline and body, then badges and CTA) with clear hierarchy, but GLACIER is off-axis from the headline, the badges and CTA are crowded toward the right edge, and the body text is small.
